judge.reason: The diff matches R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT. In `price`, each line with 10 or more units gets 5% off, rounded down with Math.floor. The discount code is then applied to the subtotal minus that volume discount, so it comes after, as required. The combined discount is capped at MAX_DISCOUNT_PERCENT (50%) of the subtotal, so the volume discount counts toward the cap. Checkout now passes the cart lines to `price`, so the discount reaches real orders. The new tests check the rule itself. One covers per-line eligibility and rounding with a code applied afterwards: 9 cents of volume discount plus 108 cents from the code. One covers the 50% cap on the combined discount. One checks that checkout charges the discounted total. I worked through the expected numbers and they match what the code produces.

finalMessage:
